# Exhibit On Superior

> Luxury River North Chicago apartment community at 165 W Superior St, Chicago, IL 60654. Studio, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom homes with a full-floor amenity deck, pool, fitness center, and dog spa. Managed by Highland Partners. Phone 312-450-0635, email exhibit@highlandptrs.com.

## Key facts

- Address: 165 W Superior St, Chicago, IL 60654 (River North, steps from the Brown Line Chicago stop)
- Home types: Studio, 1BR, 2BR, and 3BR apartments
- Pets: Dog- and cat-friendly, with on-site dog spa and pet amenities
- Tours: In-person and virtual tours available by appointment
- Leasing contact: 312-450-0635 / exhibit@highlandptrs.com
- Management: Highland Partners
